projecthero.guide.power_tiers.body: Every power is balanced to one of four tiers: Street, City, Planet and Cosmic. A tier sets how hard its basic hits, abilities and ultimate land (damage in health points, 2 = one heart) and how tough it keeps you. Buffs and marks can push a hit higher, but never past the tier's ultimate.
projecthero.guide.power_tiers.placed: A power's tier shows under its name on its Guidebook page and in the I menu. Street: Super Soldier, the Punisher, Black Panther and Power Armour. More powers get their tier in later updates.
